breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for the polar moment of inertia in both the shear stress formula (τ_max = T c / J) and the angle of twist formula (φ = TL/(JG)). The incorrect instruction to use the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in torsion relations has been completely removed, aligning with the ground truth prompt.
